Harbor retries transient HTTP 429 and 503 failures at most three times. Retry delays use exponential backoff with jitter. A Retry-After header takes precedence over the calculated delay. Authentication failures are never retried.

Harbor report cache entries expire after 24 hours. Cached reports are isolated by workspace and model version. A fresh-research option bypasses the cache. Deleting a workspace removes its cached reports.

Harbor ingests HTML, plain text, and Markdown documents. The upload limit is 10 megabytes per document. Encrypted PDFs and executable files are unsupported. Document ingestion records the source URL and acquisition timestamp.

Harbor splits documents into 160-word passages with a 35-word overlap. BM25 is the default retrieval method. Hybrid retrieval combines lexical and dense rankings using reciprocal rank fusion. The default evidence budget is eight passages.

Every Harbor finding must reference an existing passage ID and include a verbatim supporting quotation. Findings with unknown passage IDs are removed. Quote matching checks whether words occur in the passage. It does not prove that a claim logically follows from the quote.

Harbor exposes GET /health without authentication. POST /research requires a bearer token. The research endpoint accepts a question and up to twelve documents. Invalid input returns HTTP 422; missing credentials return HTTP 401.

Harbor blocks loopback, private, link-local, and reserved IP addresses when fetching web pages. Redirect targets are checked again before connecting. The fetcher pins the validated IP address and verifies the TLS hostname. Only HTTP and HTTPS on standard ports are allowed.

Harbor records elapsed time per pipeline stage, model identifiers, and input and output token counts. Cost estimates require explicitly configured input and output prices. Missing pricing is displayed as unknown rather than zero. Raw credentials are never written to run traces.

Harbor runs on Python 3.12. The browser application listens on port 8501, while the REST API listens on port 8000. A container health check polls /_stcore/health. Public deployments require authentication and an outbound network policy.

Harbor stores report history for 30 days. Workspace owners can delete their history sooner. Source documents are included only in user-requested exports. Operational logs contain run IDs and aggregate metrics, not full source text.
